assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are low-confidence design-model outputs and must be regenerated as one package when official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, road redlines, ownership, utilities, heritage controls and engineering capacity are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No parcel demolition, statutory control or engineering-feasibility conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Hong Kong precedents are transferred as principles - transit integration, vertical mix, weather protection and lifecycle operations - rather than copied forms.
assumptions.impact: Beijing winter sun, wind, heritage, public access and local approvals govern every later design stage.

assumptions.statement: Every elevated, underground or digitally mediated route must retain a visible, step-free and free-to-use at-grade equivalent with human assistance where required.
assumptions.impact: The proposal rejects podium privatization and AI-only access as a condition of design progression.

assumptions.statement: Building polygons are conceptual envelope prototypes around the three provisional key areas.
assumptions.impact: They do not identify existing buildings or authorize retain, renovate, demolish or new-build actions.
